maddeler.e:
تظاهرت (form VI)
# تَظَاهَرْتُ (taẓāhartu) /ta.ðˤaː.har.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
# تَظَاهَرْتَ (taẓāharta) /ta.ðˤaː.har.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
# تَظَاهَرْتِ (taẓāharti) /ta.ðˤaː.har.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
# تَظَاهَرَتْ (taẓāharat) /ta.ðˤaː.ha.rat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
